name: gramps-web-mcp
description: MCP server for Gramps Web — structured AI agent access to your family tree over HTTP.

ports.name: MCP HTTP Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to container port 8080 (MCP endpoint at /mcp).

variables.name: Gramps API URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Gramps Web instance (no trailing slash).

variables.name: Gramps Password
variables.description: Gramps Web API password or token.

variables.name: Gramps Tree ID
variables.description: Tree UUID on the Gramps Web server.

variables.name: Read Only Mode
variables.description: Set to true to block create, update, and delete tool calls while keeping tools visible.

variables.name: MCP API Key
variables.description: Optional API key for HTTP/SSE access (Bearer or X-Api-Key). Recommended when the MCP port is reachable from other machines.

variables.name: Mutation Serialize
variables.description: Serialize create, update, and delete HTTP calls in-process to reduce SQLite lock errors.

variables.name: Mutation Min Interval MS
variables.description: Optional minimum milliseconds between mutation HTTP calls (0 disables pacing).

variables.name: Enable Media Resources
variables.description: Enable binary media tools and resources for thumbnails and full files.

variables.name: Media Max Bytes
variables.description: Maximum bytes returned by any media resource.

variables.name: Media Allowed MIME Types
variables.description: Comma-separated MIME allowlist for media downloads.

variables.name: Allow Private Media
variables.description: Allow media bytes for Gramps records marked private.
